newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 35 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 35 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 35-billion-bolivar auction of 177-, 269- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 23.10 percent.

The bank said it would offer 25 billion bolivars worth of 177-day bills with a nominal interest rate of 21.89 percent, 5 billion bolivars of 269-day bills at 22.50 percent and 5 billion bolivars of 358-day bills at 23.10 percent.
At its auction last week, the central bank sold 60 billion bolivars worth of 177-day, 269-day and 358-day bills, with yields of 21.89, 23.39 and 24.42 percent, respectively.
